Acotados a este brain; el rol de un toke: Scoped to this brain; a token's role never exceeds yours and it cannot be an administrator.
Cualquier endpoint compatible con OpenAI: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint; the default engine is used and keys are stored encrypted.
Elige tu agente y copia lo que necesita,: Pick your agent and copy what it needs, already filled in with this server, this brain and a token.
Es opcional: por defecto solo entran las: It is optional: by default only people who already have an account can sign in. Each provider has its own automatic sign-up policy and group-based roles.
Lo que ya hay en la base de datos en uso: What the database in use already holds.
Los avisos también aparecen siempre en l: Alerts always appear in the interface bell too, with or without channels.
Los fallos se reintentan solos con esper: Failures retry on their own with growing waits; those that run out of attempts can be retried by hand.
Los vectores guardados dependen del mode: Stored vectors depend on the model: to move to an engine with another model use “Reindex”, which computes them all in shadow before switching.
Modelos de decisión cerrada para el tria: Closed-decision models for proposal triage and the type corrector.
Motores de embeddings (recall, índice de: Embedding engines (recall, text index and ingestion).
Motores que extraen hechos al ingerir pr: Engines that extract facts when proposals are ingested.
Métricas de Prometheus en /metrics: tiem: Prometheus metrics at /metrics: recall time, jobs, proposals, documents and calls to the AI engines.
Prestar la lectura de este brain a otros: Lend this brain's read access to others, or see who it receives from.
Se pone en verde en cuanto el agente hac: It turns green as soon as the agent makes its first call.
Se usa para enviar invitaciones y enlace: It is used to send invitations and password recovery links.
Sin autenticación: todos son administrad: No authentication: everyone is an administrator.
Solo aprueban lo factual con confianza s: They only approve what is factual with enough confidence; anything doubtful goes to a curator.
Solo responden a quien presenta el token: They only answer to whoever presents the token generated here.
Un grafo que no es de ningún brain se pu: A graph that is no brain's can be adopted as it is; one you do not adopt is never touched.
